maddeler.e:
ننجرف (form VII)
# نَنْجَرِفُ (nanjarifu) /nan.d͡ʒa.ri.fu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْجَرَفَ (injarafa)
# نَنْجَرِفَ (nanjarifa) /nan.d͡ʒa.ri.fa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْجَرَفَ (injarafa)
# نَنْجَرِفْ (nanjarif) /nan.d͡ʒa.rif/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْجَرَفَ (injarafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
